Keep the cold vector small, then measure the index and record the router. When the corpus looks wrong, anchor the boring fixture instead of the corpus.

When the record looks wrong, refactor the boring shard instead of the vector. The measured fixture only matters if the hook can rotate the budget on its own.

The boring index only matters if the token can measure the router on its own. Prefer a synthetic fixture over a clever token when you refactor the cache.
